from_amount.description: Amount to quote, in human-readable source-token units: '3' means 3 USDC, whether from_token is USDC or its contract address. Decimals are resolved from chain-specific token metadata. Prefix an integer with '!' for explicit smallest units: '!3000000' means 3 USDC with 6 decimals. Plain '3000000' means 3 million tokens. Positive amounts only; excess decimal places are rejected without rounding.

from_chain.description: Source chain — name (ethereum, base, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, bsc, avalanche) or chain ID integer.

from_token.description: Source token — symbol (ETH, USDC, WBTC, USDT, MATIC, LINK) or ERC-20 contract address.

slippage.description: Max slippage tolerance as a decimal (0.005 = 0.5%). Default 0.03 (3%).

to_chain.description: Destination chain. Same as from_chain for same-chain swaps. Use chain name or ID.

to_token.description: Destination token — symbol or ERC-20 contract address.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection.
